scene: The brass pin robot drops a glowing pin into your waiting hands.
picture: A flat side view of the lane's end. On the far left sits a sparkling purple ball in the ball return. Left of centre, the player in red bomber jacket and white roller skates holds a glowing pin. On the right stands the brass pin-setting robot with an open chest panel, juggling glowing pins on the far right.
shown: a glowing yellow bowling pin mid-air on the far right
an open maintenance panel buzzing with sparks on the robot's chest at right
a sparkly purple bowling ball sitting in a return rack on the left

variants.scene: The multi-armed brass robot hands you a warm, glowing yellow bowling pin.
Neon lights hum as you catch a shiny pin from the juggling automaton.
